title: Integrate final rehearsal source
goal: After T005 and T006 are terminal and independently reviewed, verify their immutable artifacts and exact terminal Git commits, then integrate the exact T005 commit with the exact T006 integration commit inside the Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree using ancestry-preserving Git merge semantics. The resulting reviewed final integration commit must retain T005 and T006—and transitively T001/T002—as Git ancestors and becomes the source identity for the leased content-addressed rehearsal-source artifact. T007 publishes no remote Git ref; T008 is the only task authorized to publish this final lineage through a protected Heim-PC pull request and convert the actual merged main tree into T003's published-source artifact.

approval.note: This task may read and mutate the exclusively reserved Heim-PC Git object/ref store only through its Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree and local run-scoped non-main workspace branch. It may read the exact immutable activation-source and rehearsal-patch artifacts and create the bound rehearsal-source artifact. Before integration, the exact T006 and T005 terminal commit objects must exist in the claimed Git object store and match the artifact manifests. Integration must preserve both exact commits as ancestors; squash, rebase, cherry-pick or patch-only substitution that loses ancestry is outside authority. No git push or remote ref mutation is authorized or required. It does not merge to main and grants no runtime, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or production-cutover authority.

acceptance.assertion: T007 begins only after T005 and T006 are terminal and independently reviewed. Evidence binds the exact content-addressed artifact.heim-pc.nixos-activation-source manifest from T006 and artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-patch manifest from T005, including their exact source commits/trees, content digests and review evidence. Missing, mutable, mismatched or ambiguous artifact identity fails closed before integration mutation.

Before reading predecessor commit objects or creating the local final-integration commit, the task holds the exclusive component.heim-pc.nixos-source-integration claim materialized as path:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git; lease loss or object/ref-store drift fails closed before another Git mutation.

Before the first Git/index/tree mutation, the execution envelope contains a non-null Bureau workspace whose workspace_path, workspace_branch, baseline_commit and source_head_at_intent are bound to this exact run. All final integration mutation and validation occurs only there; a missing workspace, reused fixed integration worktree, branch mismatch, dirty preimage or run/workspace identity drift fails closed.

After independently re-hashing both immutable input artifacts, T007 reads the exact T006 and T005 terminal commit objects from the exclusively claimed Git object store, verifies each commit/tree against its artifact manifest, and proves the T006 commit already has exact T001 and T002 terminal commits as ancestors. A missing commit object, artifact/tree mismatch or broken T001/T002 ancestry fails closed. No predecessor live worktree or moving Git ref is accepted as authority.

Inside the exact run-scoped workspace, T007 creates the final local integration commit by ancestry-preserving Git merge operations whose history contains the exact T006 integration commit and exact T005 terminal commit as ancestors. Squash, rebase, cherry-pick or patch replay that would preserve only the tree but lose either commit lineage is rejected. Any conflict is explicitly reviewed, and tree/diff comparison proves the final revision contains exactly the reviewed T006 source plus reviewed T005 changes and no unrelated source change.

Focused T001/T002/T005 tests plus required Heim-PC repository validation are green in the exact run-scoped final-integration worktree on the exact final integration commit/tree, and independent review finds no material integration regression before the rehearsal-source artifact is created.

While holding the exclusive artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-source write claim, T007 creates a content-addressed whole-source artifact and immutable manifest from the exact reviewed final integration tree. The manifest binds the exact T007 final commit/tree, exact T006/T005 predecessor commits, proven transitive T001/T002 ancestry, both input artifact digests, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity; immediate independent re-hash/readback proves artifact contents match the reviewed source tree. This artifact—not any moving Git ref—is the immutable source and lineage input for T008 protected publication; T003 later consumes only T008's published-source artifact derived from actual merged main.

T007 performs no git push and creates or updates no remote Git ref. Its Bureau-generated workspace branch is local/run-scoped only. T008 is the sole successor authorized to publish the exact final T007 commit lineage through its separately leased fixed remote branch and protected PR contract.

T007 terminal evidence exposes to T008 the exact final T007 commit/tree, rehearsal-source artifact manifest/digest and full predecessor ancestry proof. T008 must reject any publication candidate that is not descended from this exact T007 commit or whose source tree differs from the artifact except for a separately reviewed merge of legitimate fresh Heim-PC main history. After protected merge, T008—not T007—creates T003's main-bound published-source artifact.

T007 performs no remote branch publication, main-branch merge, production NixOS activation, partitioning, formatting, LUKS/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, reboot or equivalent production-cutover effect.

metadata.workspace_contract: Bureau run-scoped worktree and local non-main branch recorded in the execution envelope
